response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong general engineering skills, but has no demonstrated experience in the core requirements of this role: SoC/IP modeling, hardware performance architecture, AI accelerator or GPU workload analysis, or hardware-software co-design. His low-latency DLang systems work and embedded exposure are tangential at best, and there is no deep-learning or computer-architecture background to build on for a Principal-level hardware performance position.
strengths: 18+ years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree, satisfying general experience thresholds
Some systems-level and performance experience (low-latency async I/O services in DLang, C/C++ at National Instruments)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: testing, open source contributions, and technical community leadership
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware performance analysis experience
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU, or SIMD/MIMD architecture background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product development, misaligned with a Principal Performance Architect role

key_factors.factor: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / GPU / deep-learning workload expertise
General seniority and some low-level performance work
